created_prompt: Please create a three-year plan for a cooking influencer by the name of Julie who has 1.2 million followers that helps to grow her online presence and helps her become a published cookbook author. Julie is most known for her quick and healthy recipes, so her cooking videos and future cookbook should focus on these to maintain her core audience. When formulating the three-year plan, remember these contraints: Julie has both limited time and budget, and she works four days out of the week.
